newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy aims for soft landing on car scheme - minister.
newsitem.headline: Italy aims for soft landing on car scheme - minister.

text.p: Italian Industry Minister Pier Luigi Bersani indicated on Wednesday the government would seek a soft landing for the end of a car incentive scheme which is due to run until September.
Bersani said on the margins of a meeting here: "I believe we will try to make an intelligent exit."
"We're are only in July and we are thinking about it," he added.
The car scheme began at the start of this year and has boosted the depressed domestic market enormously.
The government has been offering incentives for people to scrap vehicles of 10 or more years old and buy new ones.
